recipe.name: Kiwi Raspberry Yoghurt Bowl with Seed Mix
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl and stir in the whey protein powder until smooth.
Top with sliced kiwi, raspberries and grapes.
Sprinkle flaxseeds, chia seeds, hemp seeds and chopped walnuts over the top.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Salmon and Black Bean Salad with Fennel and Mustard Greens
instructions: Season salmon with salt and pepper, pan-sear skin-side down for 4-5 minutes then flip for 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
Toss mustard greens, fennel, black beans, olives, parsley and grapes in a large bowl.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper for the dressing and pour over the salad.
Plate the salad and top with the seared salmon fillet, flaked slightly.

recipe.name: Grilled Turkey Tacos with Black Bean-Kidney Bean Rice and Charred Salsa
instructions: Rub turkey steak with cumin, chili powder, garlic, salt and a little olive oil; let sit 5 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear turkey over medium-high heat 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice thinly.
Warm black beans and kidney beans with a splash of water and pinch of cumin; combine with cooked rice.
Char tomato and red onion briefly in a hot dry pan, then mix with lime juice and parsley for a fresh salsa.
Warm tortillas on a grill or dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with sliced turkey and salsa, serve alongside the bean rice.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Peppermint and Parsley Seasoned Boiled Eggs
instructions: Peel and halve the boiled eggs.
Finely chop parsley and peppermint and sprinkle over the eggs with lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Serve with fresh raspberries on the side.

recipe.name: Sardine & Mackerel Pâté on Whole-Grain Toast with Fennel

ingredients.name: Tinned sardines in olive oil, drained
Tinned mackerel in olive oil, drained

instructions: Mash sardines and mackerel together with a fork in a bowl.
Mix in cream cheese, chopped fennel, parsley and lemon juice until well combined.
Season with black pepper.
Toast the whole-grain bread slices.
Spread the pâté generously over the toast and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Tandoori Turkey Skewer Bite with Charred Fennel

ingredients.name: Tandoori spice mix (paprika, cumin, coriander, chili)

instructions: Mix yoghurt, ghee, tandoori spices, garlic, ginger and lemon juice into a marinade.
Coat turkey pieces in the marinade and let sit 10 minutes.
Skewer turkey and roast/grill at high heat for 12-15 minutes, turning until charred and cooked through.
Toss fennel slices in the pan drippings and roast alongside for the last 8 minutes.
Serve the turkey skewer with the charred fennel.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Toasted Pumpkin Seed and Walnut Bite
instructions: Combine toasted pumpkin seeds, walnuts and sunflower seeds in a small bowl.
Serve as a small snack portion.

recipe.name: Kidney Bean & Turkey Beans on Toast
instructions: Heat olive oil in a small pan and sauté paprika briefly.
Add kidney beans and tomato passata, simmer 8 minutes until thickened.
Stir in cooked diced turkey and warm through.
Toast the whole-grain bread slice.
Spoon the bean and turkey mixture over the toast.
Scatter fresh parsley on top and serve.

recipe.name: Thai Braised Salmon in Coconut-Green Curry Broth
instructions: In a heavy pot, warm the green curry paste until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and fish sauce, stir to combine and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add kaffir lime leaves and fennel slices, cover and braise gently for 10 minutes.
Nestle the salmon fillet into the broth, cover and braise on low heat for 10-12 minutes until just cooked through.
Add mustard greens in the last 3 minutes, letting them wilt into the broth.
Rest the pot off heat for 5 minutes to let flavours deepen.
Finish with lime juice, fresh chili and mint before serving in a bowl with the broth.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Kiwi Raspberry Yoghurt Cup with Mint
instructions: Whisk whey protein powder into the Greek yoghurt until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl or cup.
Top with sliced kiwifruit and raspberries.
Garnish with chopped fresh mint and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Scrambled Eggs and Smoked Salmon on Toast with Fennel & Parsley
instructions: Whisk eggs and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat and scramble eggs gently until just set.
Toast the whole-grain bread until golden.
Thinly slice fennel and sauté briefly in the same pan for 1-2 minutes, or serve raw for crunch.
Top toast with scrambled eggs, flaked smoked salmon, sautéed fennel and chopped parsley.
Serve with fresh halved grapes on the side.

recipe.name: Japanese Turkey and Black Bean Curry with Mustard Greens
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger in a splash of water or dashi over medium heat until fragrant.
Add diced turkey and cook until lightly browned on all sides.
Stir in curry powder and cook for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Pour in dashi stock and soy sauce, bring to a simmer.
Add black beans and fennel, simmer for 10 minutes until turkey is cooked through.
Stir in mustard greens and cook for 2 more minutes until just wilted.
Serve hot as a light Japanese-style curry.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Kiwi and Raspberry Turkey Bites with Peppermint
instructions: Arrange sliced turkey, kiwifruit and raspberries on a small plate.
Scatter chopped fresh peppermint leaves over the top.
Serve immediately as a refreshing protein-fruit snack.

recipe.name: Raspberry Kiwi Protein Shake
instructions: Add water, protein powder and creatine to a blender.
Add frozen raspberries, peeled kiwifruit, Greek yoghurt and chia seeds.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Greek Sheet-Pan Salmon with Fennel, Olives and Mustard Greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Slice fennel bulb and toss on a lined tray with olive oil, garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt.
Roast fennel for 10 minutes, then push to one side and add salmon fillet skin-side down and olives.
Roast a further 12-15 minutes until salmon is just cooked through.
Scatter mustard greens over the tray in the last 3 minutes to wilt slightly.
Squeeze lemon juice over everything, sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Peppermint & Parsley Boiled Eggs with Fennel Seed
instructions: Place eggs in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil, then simmer for 8 minutes.
Cool eggs in cold water, peel and halve.
Finely chop parsley and peppermint leaves and toast fennel seeds lightly in a dry pan.
Sprinkle eggs with sea salt, toasted fennel seeds, parsley and peppermint.
Serve alongside fresh grapes.

recipe.name: Kiwi Raspberry Yoghurt Bowl with Whey Boost
instructions: Whisk whey protein powder into the yoghurt until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl.
Top with kiwifruit, raspberries and grapes.
Sprinkle over chia seeds, hemp seeds and chopped walnuts.
Garnish with fresh chopped mint and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Korean Turkey and Black Bean Stir Fry with Mustard Greens
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering.
Add diced turkey and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until browned and just cooked through.
Add garlic, ginger and fennel; stir-fry for 2 minutes until fragrant and slightly softened.
Add mustard greens and black beans, tossing for 2 minutes until greens wilt.
Stir in gochujang and soy sauce, coating everything evenly, cook 1 more minute.
Remove from heat, scatter with spring onion, sesame seeds and parsley before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Toasted Walnut and Pumpkin Seed Portion with Kidney Beans
instructions: Toss cooked kidney beans with lemon juice, parsley and a pinch of sea salt.
Serve alongside toasted walnuts and pumpkin seeds as a mixed snack portion.

recipe.name: Mackerel and Fennel Pâté on Toast with Grapes

ingredients.name: Tinned mackerel in olive oil, drained

instructions: Drain mackerel and mash with a fork in a bowl.
Mix in cottage cheese, chopped fennel, parsley and lemon juice until a coarse pâté forms.
Toast the whole-grain bread slices.
Spread pâté generously over the toast.
Serve with fresh grapes on the side.

recipe.name: Grilled Turkey Kofta with Fennel, Olives and Kidney Bean Tabbouleh
instructions: Combine minced turkey with parsley, cumin, allspice and garlic; mix well and shape into 4 elongated kofta.
Brush kofta with a little olive oil and grill over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, for 10-12 minutes until charred and cooked through.
Toss sliced fennel with a little olive oil, salt and pepper and grill alongside the kofta for 6-8 minutes until softened and charred.
In a bowl, combine cooked bulgur, kidney beans, olives, cucumber, tomatoes and red onion.
Dress the bulgur salad with remaining olive oil and lemon juice, season to taste.
Plate the kofta with grilled fennel and the kidney bean tabbouleh alongside.

recipe.name: Kiwi Raspberry Yoghurt with Peppermint
instructions: Spoon Greek yoghurt into a serving bowl.
Top with sliced kiwifruit and raspberries.
Sprinkle chopped walnuts and fresh peppermint over the top before serving.

aggregated_ingredients.ginger, minced/grated: 60g total for tandoori skewers, Japanese curry, Korean stir fry
aggregated_ingredients.fennel bulb, sliced: 940g total sliced for tandoori (roasted), Thai salmon, Japanese curry, Greek sheet-pan salmon, Korean stir fry
aggregated_ingredients.mustard greens, chopped: 1100g total chopped for Thai salmon, Japanese curry, Greek sheet-pan salmon, Korean stir fry
aggregated_ingredients.black beans, cooked: 750g total portioned for tacos, Japanese curry, Korean stir fry

aggregated_ingredients.fresh parsley, chopped: 52g total chopped for tacos, Korean stir fry, Greek sheet-pan salmon

timeline.name: Start Greek sheet-pan salmon roast
timeline.description: Preheat oven to 200°C. Toss sliced fennel with olive oil, garlic, oregano and salt on a lined tray and place in oven to begin roasting; salmon and olives will be added partway through but oven stays running unattended in background while other prep continues.

timeline.name: Marinate tandoori turkey
timeline.description: Mix yoghurt, ghee, tandoori spice mix, garlic, ginger and lemon juice; coat diced turkey pieces and set aside to marinate while other prep happens.

timeline.name: Batch trim and portion all turkey breast
timeline.description: Trim and portion raw turkey breast for tacos (steak), tandoori skewers (diced), Japanese curry (diced) and Korean stir fry (diced) in one pass, bagging separately per recipe.

timeline.name: Batch slice fennel bulb
timeline.description: Slice all fennel needed for tandoori charred fennel, Thai braised salmon, Japanese curry, Greek sheet-pan salmon and Korean stir fry in one aggregated chopping pass.

timeline.name: Batch chop mustard greens
timeline.description: Chop all mustard greens needed for Thai salmon, Japanese curry, Greek sheet-pan salmon and Korean stir fry together.

timeline.name: Batch mince garlic and ginger
timeline.description: Mince all garlic and ginger needed across tacos, tandoori skewers, Japanese curry and Korean stir fry in one aggregated task.

timeline.name: Batch dice onion and portion black beans
timeline.description: Dice red onion (tacos) and onion (Japanese curry); measure out black beans for tacos, Japanese curry and Korean stir fry, and kidney beans for tacos.

timeline.name: Finish Greek sheet-pan salmon
timeline.description: Add salmon skin-side down and olives to the roasting tray, continue roasting; scatter mustard greens in final minutes to wilt, then remove, portion into 4 containers, cool, refrigerate.

timeline.name: Cook and skewer tandoori turkey with fennel
timeline.description: Skewer marinated turkey and roast/grill at high heat; toss reserved sliced fennel in pan drippings and roast alongside for final 8 minutes, then portion into 4 containers and refrigerate.

timeline.name: Sear turkey and assemble taco components
timeline.description: Rub turkey steak with cumin, chili powder, garlic, salt and oil; sear and slice thinly. Warm black beans and kidney beans with rice. Char tomato and onion, mix with lime juice and parsley for salsa. Warm tortillas. Portion tacos with rice into 4 containers, refrigerate.

timeline.name: Braise Thai coconut-green curry salmon
timeline.description: Warm curry paste, add coconut milk, fish sauce, kaffir lime leaves and reserved fennel; simmer, then braise salmon fillet in broth, adding mustard greens near the end. Rest, finish with lime, chili and mint, portion into 4 containers, refrigerate.

timeline.name: Simmer Japanese turkey and black bean curry
timeline.description: Sauté reserved onion, garlic and ginger, brown diced turkey, toast curry powder, add dashi, soy sauce, black beans and reserved fennel; simmer, then stir in mustard greens to wilt. Portion into 4 containers, refrigerate.

timeline.name: Stir-fry Korean turkey and black bean dish
timeline.description: Stir-fry diced turkey in sesame oil, add garlic, ginger, reserved fennel, mustard greens and black beans, finish with gochujang and soy sauce; scatter spring onion, sesame seeds and parsley. Portion into 4 containers, refrigerate.

timeline.name: Label, date and finalize refrigeration
timeline.description: All six dishes are fridge-only (each eaten within 4 days), so no freezer step is required. Label each of the 24 portions with dish name and eat-by date, then stack in fridge in airtight containers.
